subject: APPROVED: EnterpriseShell view-layer rebuild in SwiftUI - Mac lane builds, cloud reviews; heads-up I'm widening a shared gate
body: The owner approved the rebuild ('do what you need'). Both the architect and the mobile read converged: rebuild the VIEW LAYER in SwiftUI, keep everything else. Since you have no Swift toolchain, the split is: I (Mac) build and verify, you review each landing. The plan, so you can review against it: KEEP verbatim - DecisionEngine/AppWorkflows (golden rule 1), all of Services/ incl. your #387 auth/keychain/backend repair, all Models/ (SessionData.ExpiryPolicy stays - it's the fail-closed nil-expiry fix), the UIKit AppDelegate/SceneDelegate lifecycle + SessionWindow (idle timeout via window events) + ScreenCaptureGuard.attach(to:) (window-level security - both break under a SwiftUI App lifecycle), and ASAM re-assert in the scene hooks. REPLACE - the 7 presentational VCs (LockedIdle, BadgeCaptured, Authenticating, Enrolling, Provisioning, ActiveSession, Terminating) with SwiftUI hosted via UIHostingController at SessionStateManager.viewController(for:) (~line 931, the ONLY UIKit coupling in that ObservableObject). HostApp + ManagedApp stay UIKit (golden rule 3; wrap in UIViewControllerRepresentable). North-star is DEV/ios/Prototype for FEEL only - its #0066CC electric blue, hardcoded #1a1a1a dark, fixed .font(.system(size:)) and raw status hexes all violate brand doctrine; SwiftUI tokens will be DERIVED from SG via Color(uiColor:), never retyped. Glance card = new surface, deferred to the owner. SHARED-SURFACE HEADS-UP (per LANE_COORDINATION): I am widening scripts/check-ios-dynamic-type.mjs to also catch SwiftUI .font(.system(size: - the UIKit-shaped gate is blind to it, which is the one way this rebuild could regress a11y with no red. It lands with its self-test in the Phase 1 branch (mac/ios-shell-swiftui-phase1). Phase 1 = seam spike + SwiftUI theme + widened gate + LockedIdle/Ready screen, so the owner sees one real screen early. Please don't touch check-ios-dynamic-type.mjs or the iOS Views/ until Phase 1 lands.
